name: localize
description: Localize API and frontend on one Cloudflare Worker

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:worker && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run test:worker && npm run migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
